node.title: Re: What am I breaking?
node.author: bliako
node.doctext:
In our @num2nam = (... [ six => 0.1.1], ...) not quoting the values (e.g. 0.1.1) results in unprintable characters (0.1.1 concatenates ascii 0, 1 and 1 to a string) that confuse eval. After fixing it, you will only have to find why $res is undefined.

Edit: I am slightly out of my depth here as I was not aware of the "version strings" before [haukex]'s [id://1233540]. Although quoting the version strings may have fixed the problem, there is the danger of short-circuiting the test logic. Perhaps one can sprintf() those naked version strings using the special sprintf formatter mentioned by [AnomalousMonk].

bw, bliako
